# awscc_bedrockagentcore_gateway_rate_limit (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::BedrockAgentCore::GatewayRateLimit



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `description` (String) Optional human-readable description for this limit.
- `dimension_keys` (List of String) Ordered list of dimension names defining the scope of this limit.
Unique per gateway — no two limits can share the same dimensionKeys.
- `entries` (Attributes List) Rule entries mapping dimension values to rate configurations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))
- `gateway_identifier` (String)
- `rate_limit_id` (String) Limit identifier. Optional on Create (system-generates if not provided by customer).
Always present in responses.
- `status` (String) Status of a gateway limit
- `updated_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `connections` (Attributes List) Connection rate limits (per second only). Limited to 1 entry for now. — P2 (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries--connections))
- `dimensions` (Map of String) Map of dimension name to dimension value for a rule entry
- `requests` (Attributes List) Request rate limits (RPS or RPM). Limited to 1 entry for now. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries--requests))
- `tokens` (Attributes List) Token rate limits (TPM). Limited to 1 entry for now. — P1 (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries--tokens))

<a id="nestedatt--entries--connections"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries.connections`

Read-Only:

- `period` (String) Time period for rate limiting
- `rate` (Number)


<a id="nestedatt--entries--requests"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries.requests`

Read-Only:

- `period` (String) Time period for rate limiting
- `rate` (Number)


<a id="nestedatt--entries--tokens"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries.tokens`

Read-Only:

- `period` (String) Time period for rate limiting
- `rate` (Number)
